2609.15009.title: CoMem: Collective-Individual Memory Synergy for Evolutionary Multi-Agent Systems
2609.15009.paper_summary: Designing effective memory mechanisms is crucial for advancing LLM-driven Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), helping agents learn together and perform better over time. While recent work has led to strong cooperation skills, most methods still use flat, unstructured memories, which easily get filled with noise and erase differences between agents. To address this, we introduce the concept of collective-individual memory synergy and propose CoMem, an architecture that unifies both private experience and shared knowledge for multi-agent learning. CoMem features:(i) Private Experience Sedimentation, which lets each agent keep and update its own useful memories over time;(ii) Collective Wisdom Curation, which carefully selects only widely proven ideas to be shared among agents;(iii)Parallel Dual-Stream Retrieval, which allows agents to draw both from their own memory and the group's wisdom, using clustering to ensure diversity.Experiments on ALFWorld and PDDL benchmarks show that CoMem achieves strong overall performance and robustly avoids memory pollution.
2609.15009.paper_summary_zh: 設計有效的記憶機制對於推進基於 LLM 的多代理系統 (MAS) 至關重要，幫助代理一起學習並隨著時間的推移表現更好。雖然最近的研究已經促進了強大的合作技能，但大多數方法仍然使用平坦且無結構的記憶，這容易被噪音填滿並抹去代理之間的差異。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了集體-個體記憶協同的概念，並提出了 CoMem，一種統一私人經驗和共享知識的多代理學習架構。CoMem 的特點包括：(i) 私人經驗沉澱，讓每個代理隨著時間的推移保留和更新自己的有用記憶；(ii) 集體智慧策展，仔細選擇只有廣泛證明的想法在代理之間共享；(iii) 平行雙流檢索，允許代理同時從自己的記憶和群體的智慧中獲取信息，並使用聚類來確保多樣性。在 ALFWorld 和 PDDL 基準上的實驗顯示，CoMem 實現了強大的整體性能並穩健地避免了記憶污染。
